ModMetaData.name: RimMT Wait Root Cause Probe v0.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Bounded diagnostic probe for repeated player-colonist Wait outcomes. Captures the actual DetermineNextJob and JobGiver_Work path, WorkGiver eligibility rejection reasons and nearest-candidate results on the main thread. Automatically stops after its bounded capture budget. It does not change jobs or gameplay results.
